title: SOME/IP: Filter enhancements for service names and method names
description:
## Summary
- Add optional explicit display filter fields for SOME/IP services so analysts can rely on Wireshark auto-complete instead of typing raw strings.
- Introduce per-service and per service+method header fields (e.g., `someip.service.MyService`, `someip.method.MyService.MyMethod`) that are generated dynamically from the configured UAT tables.
- Provide a new preference (`Use explicit service name fields for filtering`) to toggle between the legacy single-field behavior (default) and the new auto-generated fields.
- Make it significantly easier to pinpoint the desired services or specific service/method pairs when filtering traces, since Wireshark now suggests the exact filter tokens.

## Implementation Details
- Added preference flag (`someip_service_name_fields_explicit`) and registered it with descriptive text in `proto_register_someip`.
- Extended UAT handling for services and methods to mark them as `UAT_AFFECTS_FIELDS`, ensuring preferences/UAT updates refresh the dynamic header fields.
- Introduced dynamic header field arrays and hash tables for both per-service and per service+method filters; fields are created/destroyed based on the preference state.
- Updated `proto_reg_handoff_someip` to rebuild the dynamic fields whenever preferences change, without disturbing the existing service/method lookup tables.
- Enhanced the dissector logic to emit the appropriate field (generic vs. explicit) during packet dissection, including the new combined service+method field under the `someip.method` prefix.
